snippet.title: 100 Hidden ASCII Cats - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4651840/100_Hidden_ASCII_Cats

A cozy hidden-object puzzle set in massive worlds drawn entirely from ASCII text. Grab your magnifying glass and find 100 kittens hiding between the characters.
